events.title: Revolutionizing Healthcare With AI-Powered Devices
events.description: You are invited to join the Weill Cornell Medicine community for a showcase of digital health innovations and technologies. This event is part of #AIWeekNY, a community-led festival organized by Pulse NYC that celebrates innovation across the AI ecosystem. The following innovators and their AI-enabled technologies will be featured: EmulatRx An agentic AI platform that uses real-world patient data to support clinical trial design. Presented by Weishen Pan, PhD, Research Associate, Department of Population Health Sciences, Weill Cornell Medicine WAV AI An AI-based tool that analyzes sounds to detect fistula stenosis. Presented by Bobak Mosadegh, PhD, Associate Professor of Biomedical Engineering in Radiology and Director, Dalio Institute of Cardiovascular Imaging, Weill Cornell Medicine Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction An Epic-integrated clinical decision support tool that analyzes electronic health record data to identify pregnant patients at elevated risk for postpartum depression. Presented by Yiye Zhang, PhD, MS, Associate Professor of Population Health Sciences, Weill Cornell Medicine Corneal Confocal Microscopy for Neurodegenerative Disease Detection A noninvasive approach that uses corneal confocal microscopy to detect changes in the cornea’s small nerve fibers. Quantitative imaging and predictive analysis may offer an accessible biomarker for detecting and monitoring neurodegeneration. Presented by Rayaz A. Malik, MBChB, PhD, FRCP, Professor of Medicine, Weill Cornell Medicine–Qatar We look forward to seeing you there!

event.title: Studio Walk-In Office Hour
event.description:
Studio is the heart of the Cornell Tech experience. At roughly a quarter of your coursework, it's where you'll take on real problems for real companies, build products, and learn what it takes to launch a venture in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment. A little prep over the summer will help you start strong in the fall.

event.title: Field Conditions: Incubating Media Arts in NYC
event.description: New York’s art / design / technology field is held together by a coalition between practices and cultural institutions that shape what gets made, who gets supported, and what survives. This panel brings together NEW INC at the New Museum, Rhizome, and Onassis ONX, New York City institutions that have an ongoing commitment to Art, Design and Technology. The conversation will look at how each organization identifies and supports practitioners, where funding and institutional models are heading, and what is actually emerging in practice right now. For anyone working across computational design, interaction, immersive media, and creative technology, it offers a direct view of the infrastructure behind the work and of what it takes to build a practice in this city.
